well.line: I'm long since dead and I live in Hell
stanza: I'm long since dead and I live in Hell
She's the only girl that I love well
We were raised together and together we fell
God is what I make of Him

partner.line: She's the only girl that I love well

stanza: We busked around the market towns
And picked fruit down in Kent
And we could tinker lamps and pots
And knives wherever we went
And I said that we might settle down
Get a few acres dug
Fire burning in the hearth
And babies on the rug
She said, "Oh man, you foolish man
It surely sounds like hell
You might be lord of half the world
You'll not own me as well"

partner.line: You'll not own me as well"

stanza: There's foxes in the henhouse
Cows out in the corn
The unions have been busted
Their proud red banners torn
To listen to the radio
You'd think that all was well
But you and me and Cisco know
It's going straight to hell

partner.line: You'd think that all was well

well.line: And if a better blade was ever made, it was prob'ly forged in hell
stanza: My father had a Randall knife, my mother gave it to him
When he went off to World War II to save us all from ruin
Now if you've ever held a Randall knife, you know my father well
And if a better blade was ever made, it was prob'ly forged in hell

partner.line: Now if you've ever held a Randall knife, you know my father well

stanza: And she wakes my days with a glad face
She fakes and says I'm a hard case
She makes and plays like a bad ace
Carrying my ways into scarred space
And she knows me well
Ah but what the hell
Only time can tell, where we're going to

well.line: I thought that I was stuck in Hell
stanza: "This ain't going well"
I thought that I was stuck in Hell
In a boring conversation with a girl called Mel
About her friend in Cincinnati called Matty as well
You pulled away when I went in for the kiss
No, it wasn't a diss
You put the tap on to cover up the sound of your piss
After four years, don't you think I'm over all this?
"That's rich from a man who can't shit in a hotel room
He's gotta share for a bit"
You make a little hobby out of going to the lobby
To get things that they don't have

well.songTitle: We the People Who Are Darker Than Blue
well.line: High yellow gal, can't you tell
stanza: We people who are darker than blue
This ain't no time for segregatin'
I'm talking 'bout brown and yellow, too
High yellow gal, can't you tell
You're just the surface of our dark, deep well?
If your mind could really see
You'd know your color the same as me
Pardon me, brother, as you stand in your glory
I know you won't mind if I tell the whole story

partner.line: You're just the surface of our dark, deep well?

stanza: If your memory serves you well
We're going to meet again and wait
So I'm going to unpack all my things
And sit before it gets too late
No man alive will come to you
With another tale to tell
And you know that we shall meet again
If your memory serves you well

partner.line: If your memory serves you well

well.line: Dancin' around the lies we tell
stanza: Dancin' around the lies we tell
Dancin' around big eyes, as well
Even the comatose
They don't dance and tell

partner.line: Dancin' around big eyes, as well

well.line: Maybe she knows and she won’t tell
stanza: And the clusters fell like an empty bell
Meteor shower at the motel
Where the empty space is a saving grace
Making good time and doing well
Still the question sings like Saturn’s rings
Maybe she knows and she won’t tell

partner.line: Making good time and doing well

tell.line: I've given up on ever being well
stanza: I guess I've got a taste for poison
I've given up on ever being well
I keep mining the horizon
Digging for lies I've yet to tell
I wish you were here to softly say name
Calm down all the chemicals tearing through my brain
I don't think I've missed you this much since I was seventeen
I'd call you in the morning but I think this is a dream
